fusions.name: Needle Fan
fusions.desc: Looses 3 stings at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 poison damage with a 30% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Booted Hive
fusions.desc: Kicks a hive that deals 28 poison damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. It then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Nectar Run
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Scout Drone
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded drone that flies beside you, stinging an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds and leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
